lines.zh: 身子一伸一缩，慢慢向前。
lines.en: Stretch and contract, on I creep.

lines.zh: 我的身体在地上一拱一拱。
lines.en: My body humps along the ground.
Fine grit trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕过一块石头。
lines.en: I slowly round a stone.

lines.zh: 我朝着有铁味的地方爬。
lines.en: I crawl toward the smell of iron.
My segments contract and release.
I crawl small and unassuming.
I slip between grass roots.
I shift half a block along the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬头探了一下，又低头爬。
lines.en: I lift to look, then lower and crawl.
I drag a stubby tail.
I advance a little at a time.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来一小段。
lines.en: I poke a stretch out of the soil.
I crawl toward your feet.
I swing in an arc and go on.

lines.zh: 我的身体软软地贴地滑。
lines.en: My body slides soft along the ground.
I curl on the dirt, still.
My segments draw tight.
I wait for someone to bring iron.
I raise my head and sway.

lines.zh: 我的身体慢慢鼓了一下。
lines.en: My body swells slowly once.
I rest on a leaf, quiet.
I barely open my eyes.
I daze among the soil grains.
I let out a slow breath.
My tail tip curls.

lines.zh: 我不动，就像一块小小的石头。
lines.en: I stay still as a pebble.
I listen for something underground.
I raise my head to you.
I sway my head side to side.
You are huge, and I am not afraid.
I shift a little your way.
I sniff your hand.
Your hand moves and I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 我仰着头看你手里的铁。
lines.en: I look up at the iron you hold.
I swing my head around to face you.
I press close to your boot.

lines.zh: 我吱了一声，细得像草响。
lines.en: I chirp, thin as rustling grass.
I roll my body into a ring.
Half my length is already under the soil.
I squirm twice and stop.
The pain curls me into a ball.
One of my segments dents.
I drag half my body clear.
My head droops.
My whole body shudders once.
I coil tighter.
I dare not move again.
I smell iron and rush over.
I bite onto the iron.

lines.zh: 我围着铁块打转，舍不得走。
lines.en: I circle the iron, unwilling to leave.
I pin it down and gnaw.
My body brightens once.
I eat fast and intently.
I carry it off to one side.
I look up to see if you have more.
I swallow the iron whole.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边等下一块。
lines.en: I wait at your feet for another.
You step on me and I curl tight.

lines.zh: 翻过来肚皮朝上，我乱蹬。
lines.en: Flipped on my back, I kick wildly.
I am stuck in the mud on your sole.
I roll half a block and stop.
You nudge me aside.
I dive into the soil.

lines.zh: 我被踩得扁了，慢慢鼓回来。
lines.en: I get squashed flat and slowly puff back.
There is a small thing at your feet.

lines.zh: 你脚一动，我从缝里挤过。
lines.en: Your foot shifts and I squeeze past.
I slowly shift away, displeased.
Two oriworms press together.

lines.zh: 两只虫头尾相接，绕成环。
lines.en: Two worms join head to tail in a ring.

lines.zh: 头顶的须子轻轻对上了。
lines.en: The feelers on our heads touch lightly.
They crawl around each other slowly.

lines.zh: 我们的身体一节节对着。
lines.en: Our segments line up.
We burrow into the soil together.
They stop head to head.
Neither of us moves.
A layer of soil lies between them.
We push forward together.
I take it in my jaws and my teeth ache.
I coil my body around it.
I drag it along bit by bit.

lines.zh: 这东西大过我三节身子。
lines.en: That thing is longer than three of my segments.
I tuck it under a leaf vein.
I try to swallow and get stuck.
I push it into the soil.
I curl my tail around it.
I hold it and crawl slowly.
I let go and it rolls away.
I rear my front half up to look.
The smell of iron is close.
I start crawling faster.

lines.zh: 闻到铁，我整条虫都硬了。
lines.en: One whiff of iron stiffens my whole body.
I head straight for it.
I have picked the piece on the ground.
I decide to take no detour.
I lower my head and push forward.
I hug the dirt, ready to dart.
The iron is just ahead.
I go around the big stone.
My movement turns very direct.
I follow that smell the whole way.
It moves and I turn.
I cut under the grass roots.

lines.zh: 我爬得慢，但一直朝着味。
lines.en: I am slow, but I never leave the scent.
I am two body-lengths away.

lines.zh: 我一直朝一个有铁的方向。
lines.en: I keep heading toward iron.
I approach from a new angle.
I slow down, careful.
I shift through the grass segment by segment.
It grows closer.
I do not look up, only forward.
I follow the scent all the way.
I bite down on it.

lines.zh: 我把整条身子叠在它身上。
lines.en: I fold my full length over it.
I butt my head into it.
My teeth are lodged in and I do not let go.
I coil around it and tighten.

lines.zh: 尾尖甩过去，抽在它腿上。
lines.en: My tail whips across its leg.
I gnaw once and withdraw.
It gets dragged by me.
I burrow under it and heave upward.
I gnaw patiently.

lines.zh: 土里钻出一个小小的头。
lines.en: A small head pokes out of the soil.

lines.zh: 地上多了一节一节的影子。
lines.en: A segmented shadow appears on the ground.
I squeeze out of a stone crack.
There were no worms here.
I slowly push up out of the dirt.
Something is by your feet now.
I appear among the grass roots.
I begin crawling on the ground.
One segment shows first.

lines.zh: 土粒从我环节上滚下来。
lines.en: Grains of dirt roll off my segments.
I curl up with a scorched tail.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔得发软。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land soft.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱扭，浮不起来。
lines.en: I thrash in the water, unable to rise.
The blast spins me through the air.
An arrow passes through one segment.
That force pins me down.

lines.zh: 我饿得连爬的力气都没有。
lines.en: Hunger leaves me too weak to crawl.

lines.zh: 雷打在地上，我弹了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ground and I jump.

lines.zh: 下面的土没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The soil below is gone; I fall.
